# Descent TCG

> Descent TCG is a collector-run trading card shop at 5205 33rd St E, Bradenton, FL 34203.
> It buys and sells rare and vintage trading cards — Pokémon, Disney Lorcana, Magic: The
> Gathering, and One Piece — including raw singles, professionally graded slabs, and sealed
> product (booster boxes, cases, Elite Trainer Boxes). Formerly known as Ripping Zacks.
> Contact: sales@rippingzacks.com (typical response within 24–48 hours).
> Full retail inventory is hosted on the shop's TCGplayer Pro storefront: https://dig.tcgplayerpro.com/

## Key pages

- [Home](https://descenttcg.com/): Overview of the shop and how buying works.
- [Our Store](https://descenttcg.com/our-store.html): Physical shop details (address, contact) and link to the full online inventory.
- [Lorcana Vault](https://descenttcg.com/collection.html): Disney Lorcana chase cards and sealed product with prices; offers accepted on every item.
- [Slab Vault](https://descenttcg.com/slab-vault.html): Professionally graded cards with prices; offers accepted.
- [Sealed Vault](https://descenttcg.com/sealed-vault.html): Sealed booster boxes, cases, and Pokémon Center ETBs with prices; offers accepted.
- [Fort Knox Vault](https://descenttcg.com/fort-knox-vault.html): Live sealed inventory via Collectr.
- [About](https://descenttcg.com/about.html): The shop's story — collector-run since the late 1990s, formerly Ripping Zacks.
- [Contact](https://descenttcg.com/contact.html): Inquiries, valuations, and offers.

## Facts for citation

- Business name: Descent TCG (formerly Ripping Zacks)
- Type: Collector-run trading card shop (TCG singles, graded cards, sealed product)
- Address: 5205 33rd St E, Bradenton, FL 34203, United States
- Email: sales@rippingzacks.com
- Online inventory: https://dig.tcgplayerpro.com/
- Games covered: Pokémon, Disney Lorcana, Magic: The Gathering, One Piece
